title: GCU vs PurdueGlobal: control, tuition, size
summary: Grand Canyon University (GCU) versus Purdue University Global (PurdueGlobal). Also searched as PurdueGlobal vs GCU. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Purdue University Global and Grand Canyon University differ primarily in ownership, enrollment, tuition, and location. Purdue University Global is a public institution based in West Lafayette, while Grand Canyon University is a private nonprofit located in Phoenix. The undergraduate enrollment at Purdue University Global is 30,828 students, compared to 73,371 at Grand Canyon University. Tuition for in-state students at Purdue University Global is $10,101, which is lower than Grand Canyon University's $17,850. These distinctions highlight key differences between PurdueGlobal vs GCU in terms of institutional structure and student demographics.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing cost, Purdue University Global offers lower tuition rates for in-state students at $10,101, whereas Grand Canyon University charges $17,850 for all students regardless of residency. For out-of-state students, Purdue University Global's tuition is $14,412, still less than Grand Canyon University's uniform rate of $17,850. Despite the higher tuition, Grand Canyon University graduates tend to have a lower median debt of $22,114 compared to Purdue University Global's $26,078. These figures illustrate the financial considerations prospective students should evaluate when choosing between PurdueGlobal vs GCU.

sections.heading: Pick PurdueGlobal if
paragraphs: Pick PurdueGlobal if you prefer attending a public university with lower in-state tuition costs. Purdue University Global charges $10,101 for in-state tuition, which is more affordable compared to many private institutions. Additionally, the university has a completion rate of 50% within 150% of the expected time, reflecting student progress toward degree completion. These factors may appeal to students seeking a cost-effective public education option. When considering PurdueGlobal vs GCU, the public ownership and tuition structure are important aspects to evaluate.

sections.heading: Pick GCU if
paragraphs: Pick GCU if you prefer attending a private nonprofit institution, as Grand Canyon University is classified as such according to College Scorecard ownership code 2. GCU has a higher admission rate of approximately 79%, which may appeal to students seeking a less selective enrollment process. The tuition for all students at GCU is $17,850, which is higher than Purdue University Global's in-state tuition but reflects its private status. Additionally, GCU has a completion rate of about 43% within 150% of the expected time, providing insight into student persistence and graduation outcomes. These factors are important to consider when comparing PurdueGlobal vs GCU.
